scope: 12 access-route entries; dated supplement preserving original Rabbit SYS/AP records and historical totals.
status: Documentation review only. No bulk collection, account creation, credential generation, purchase, outreach or authenticated API test.

entries.name: ODP raw patent full text
entries.coverage: Patent grant and published-application full text; APPXML covers published non-provisional utility/plant applications from March 2001. Images are separate products.
entries.access_and_authentication: USPTO.gov registration required for ODP from 18 June 2026. Programmatic ODP access uses an API key; official launch guidance described ID.me-linked registration. Current account flow was not exercised.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Public data; no purchase made. Official APPXML catalog marks its data public domain. Recheck chosen product and download terms.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Use dated bulk product files rather than scrape search pages. Applications publish weekly on Thursdays. Current per-key/download quotas and latest actual files unverified.
entries.cautions: Preserve XML/SGML/APS version by file and do not assume one parser handles every historical year. Published applications, granted patents and images have different coverage.
entries.verification: Official APPXML metadata and access notices reviewed. ODP product pages returned no readable content through the web tool; files, quota and credential flow not tested.

entries.name: PatentsView research and long-text tables
entries.coverage: Disambiguated grants and pre-grant publications, inventor/organization links, government-interest fields and separate long-text products. USPTO page reports data through 31 December 2025.
entries.access_and_authentication: ODP registration applies. Use current ODP products and dictionaries. March 2026 notice paused legacy search/APIs; resumption not verified.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Open research resource; not the official legal record. No purchase or authenticated download.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Product IDs: pvgpatdis, pvpgpubdis, pvgpattxt, pvpgpubtxt, pvannual, pvsorted. Release cadence and numeric quotas unverified.
entries.cautions: Disambiguation is modelled. Keep release-specific IDs, original names and match confidence; check assignments separately.
entries.verification: USPTO page and linked product destinations reviewed. ODP pages exposed no readable data listing; no file or API test.

entries.name: Artificial Intelligence Patent Dataset 2023
entries.coverage: AI classification of 15.4 million US patent documents published during 1976–2023; includes patents and pre-grant publications.
entries.access_and_authentication: Use official release links/ODP; page warns download links now return temporary signed URLs.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Public research release; cite the methodology paper. No file retrieved.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Historical dataset, not a current feed. Use corrected 8 January 2025 release for predict93 variables.
entries.cautions: Model labels identify AI, not weapons. Validate against known examples and original claims; disclose false positives, missed cases and the 2023 cutoff.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: DOCDB worldwide bibliographic bulk
entries.coverage: Bibliographic data, abstracts, citations and simple patent families from more than 100 countries; no full text or images.
entries.access_and_authentication: BDDS download/order route; access and applicable license must be checked before collection. No account provisioned.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Listed free; EPO database license applies. See shared EPO license warning in README.
entries.bulk_and_limits: XML ST36; about 200 GB zipped backfile, twice yearly. Process backfile then exchange files, normally Tuesday/Thursday; frontfile about 3 GB zipped.
entries.cautions: Coverage differs by office and period. Family grouping is essential to avoid counting each publication as an invention.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: INPADOC worldwide legal events
entries.coverage: Events from more than 50 patent authorities, including national gazettes/registers, EPO and WIPO.
entries.access_and_authentication: BDDS; license conditions apply. Authentication/download not exercised.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Listed free; shared EPO license conditions apply.
entries.bulk_and_limits: XML ST36; twice-yearly backfile about 20 GB; weekly frontfile about 700 MB, usually Tuesday.
entries.cautions: Event coverage and national reporting vary. Recheck material ownership or in-force claims against the relevant official register.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: EP full-text bulk
entries.coverage: EP-A publications from 1978 and EP-B from 1980, including descriptions, claims and drawings.
entries.access_and_authentication: BDDS download route; no sign-in or download performed.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Listed free; shared EPO license conditions apply.
entries.bulk_and_limits: XML ST36 and PDF/A. Weekly Wednesday files about 4 GB zipped; full backfile about 3.53 TB zipped.
entries.cautions: Euro-PCT applications published by WIPO in an EPO official language are not republished in full by EPO; only minimal EP information may be present. Join to WO/PCT text where needed.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: EP bibliographic data (EBD)
entries.coverage: New EP applications/patents and recent changes: applicants, titles, filing/priority dates and classifications.
entries.access_and_authentication: BDDS or Single Access Portal; collection not tested.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Listed free; shared EPO license conditions apply.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Current-year XML ST36 frontfiles, weekly Wednesday, about 20 MB zipped. No same-format backfile.
entries.cautions: Files are not cumulative histories. European Patent Register backfile matches only partly; do not silently treat a join as complete.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: European Patent Register bulk
entries.coverage: Public EP procedural records from 1978, with history and legal/representative information in a dated snapshot.
entries.access_and_authentication: BDDS download route; collection not tested.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Listed free; shared EPO license conditions apply.
entries.bulk_and_limits: XML ST36, about 8 GB zipped, available twice yearly. No same-format frontfile.
entries.cautions: Excludes All documents and Federated Register sections. Can only partly be matched to EBD change files.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: PATSTAT / Technology Intelligence Platform
entries.coverage: Worldwide bibliographic, legal and EP procedural data for statistical analysis; release-specific relational datasets.
entries.access_and_authentication: TIP provides free access. Price page says independent bulk access is available on request after case examination. No access request made.
entries.cost_and_reuse: TIP listed free. Legacy PATSTAT Online remains subscription-based, with annual price EUR 755 on current list; distinct from free TIP.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Use SQL/structured analysis after checking current release and export conditions. Bulk approval and export limits unverified.
entries.cautions: Not a universal full-text corpus. Do not assume free TIP consultation equals permission to download or redistribute the entire database.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: Open Patent Services (OPS)
entries.coverage: REST/XML access to bibliographic, family, legal-event, full-text and image sources, with collection-dependent coverage.
entries.access_and_authentication: Registration, application credentials and OAuth required. No credentials created.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Free up to 4 GB per calendar week; EUR 2,800 annual subscription above that threshold. Terms/fair-use conditions apply.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Fair-use charter states approximately 1 Mbit/s maximum traffic; operational limits can vary. For very large sets use bulk products. Current endpoint-specific throttle headers not tested.
entries.cautions: Espacenet and register graphical interfaces are for human use, not bulk scraping. A paid subscription is not unlimited collection.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.

entries.name: Google Patents Public Datasets
entries.coverage: Compatible BigQuery patent tables for SQL search, joins and export. Underlying providers and tables differ in coverage.
entries.access_and_authentication: Google Cloud/BigQuery project and appropriate permissions required; account and queries not used here.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Public tables can still incur compute, storage and transfer costs. On-demand pricing includes first 1 TiB of query processing per month free; recheck region/account pricing.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Dry-run first, cap bytes billed, select needed columns and export only a bounded result. No numeric live quota tested.
entries.cautions: Example repository archived 18 April 2026; that does not establish dataset staleness. Verify table metadata, latest publication date and missing fields before use. Code license does not cover every dataset.
entries.verification: Publisher repository and current compute pricing reviewed. No live BigQuery table query or freshness check.

entries.name: Licensed PCT raw data and web service
entries.coverage: Published PCT international applications. Bibliographic snapshots, OCR/XML text backfiles, updates and conditional SOAP document access are separate products.
entries.access_and_authentication: Order/subscription and appropriate license required. No request submitted.
entries.cost_and_reuse: Examples: bibliographic XML snapshot CHF 1,600 per copy; full-access webservice CHF 2,000/calendar year. Other text/backfile licenses cost more; nonprofit discount listed as 50%, eligibility unverified.
entries.bulk_and_limits: Use licensed product delivery, not PATENTSCOPE harvesting. PATENTSCOPE logged-in exports cap at 10,000 results; bulk download and robots are prohibited.
entries.cautions: PCT is not all national patent data. Derivative and non-derivative rights differ; obtain terms for intended retention, analysis and publication before acquiring.
entries.verification: Official documentation reviewed; no authenticated request, dataset download or payload test.
